research_question: Owner-approved addition: Trust & Will vs LegalZoom: Wills, Trusts, Pricing, and Attorney Support. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for trust & will vs legalzoom, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.

research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; Trust & Will attorney option corrected from a $299 add-on to attorney plans starting at $1,499 for complex needs, with attorney support in the $299-a-year Pro membership; Trust & Will 'free updates' corrected to optional unlimited updates at $49 a year; LegalZoom Premium Will ($299) added; LegalZoom source moved from the AAA partner page to legalzoom.com.
